# Template: ad_as
A macroeconomic aggregate demand-aggregate supply (AD-AS) diagram: a downward-sloping AD curve, an upward-sloping AS curve, their equilibrium (price level and real GDP) with dashed guides, an optional shift of either curve (with a shift arrow between old and new, in the `shifted` color, and the new equilibrium), and an optional vertical long-run aggregate supply (LRAS) guide at potential output. Choose this scene for ANY request about aggregate demand, aggregate supply, the AD-AS model, the price level, real GDP, an inflationary or recessionary shock, or an expansionary/ contractionary demand or supply shift. shift.amount is numeric and animates smoothly — tween it to show the curve sliding and the equilibrium moving with it. Paused, the viewer can drag AD or AS (a demand or supply shock) and the equilibrium recomputes live; an explore beat naming nothing hands it over. Values {ad_as.output}, {ad_as.price}, {ad_as.output_new}, {ad_as.price_new}, {ad_as.gap} (output minus potential, with LRAS).
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "shift": {
   "type": "object",
   "description": "A shift of AD or AS, with a shift arrow and the new equilibrium.",
   "properties": {
    "curve": {
     "type": "string",
     "enum": [
      "ad",
      "as"
     ]
    },
    "direction": {
     "type": "string",
     "enum": [
      "left",
      "right"
     ]
    },
    "amount": {
     "type": "number",
     "description": "Magnitude of the shift, 0-30 (default 18)."
    }
   },
   "required": [
    "curve"
   ]
  },
  "show_lras": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Draw a vertical long-run aggregate supply guide at potential output (default false)."
  },
  "x_label": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "Default \"Real GDP\"."
  },
  "y_label": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "Default \"Price level\"."
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- axes: the coordinate axes (one group with both axis lines and their captions)
- ad: the aggregate demand curve
- as: the aggregate supply curve
- lras: vertical long-run aggregate supply guide, present when show_lras
- ad_shifted / as_shifted: the shifted curve, present when shift.curve names it
- shift_arrow: arrow from the old curve to the shifted one, present when shift is set
- eq: dot at the original AD-AS equilibrium
- guides: dashed guides from eq to both axes
- eq_new: dot at the new equilibrium after a shift, present when shift is set
- label_ad / label_as / label_ad_shifted / label_as_shifted / label_eq / label_eq_new / label_lras: labels
Examples:
Request: "Draw an aggregate demand and aggregate supply diagram." → params: {}
Request: "Show aggregate supply increasing, with the long-run aggregate supply marked." → params: {"shift":{"curve":"as","direction":"right","amount":15},"show_lras":true}

Viewer can: Drag AD or AS sideways (a demand or a supply shock); the shifted copy peels off the original, LRAS stays, output and prices follow.

In YAML: `template: ad_as` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
